top_signals.title: China warns US space weapons could fuel arms race
top_signals.summary: China urged the United States to halt its military build-up in outer space after Washington acknowledged it has weapons deployed in orbit.

top_signals.title: U.S. Oil Inventories Edge Lower as Fuel Demand Softens
top_signals.summary: Crude oil inventories in the United States saw a decrease of 600,000 barrels during the week ending September 11, according to new data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday. The decrease brings commercial stockpiles to 423.4 million barrels, according to government data, which are now 1% above with the five-year average for this time of year. The EIA’s data release follows API’s figures that were released a day earlier, which reported that crude oil inventories had gained 7.14 million barrels in…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Netherlands Coastguard Receives Patrol Vessel
top_signals.summary: Multraship, on behalf of Rijkswaterstaat, delivered the new patrol vessel ENFORCER to the Netherlands Coastguard, a 53-metre-long modern patrol vessel for surveillance work, providing assistance and contributing to safety in the North Sea. ENFORCER was built by Damen Shipyards in Gorinchem.
